properties._html:
F/V Robert Henry, Cape Arago, Oregon

2013-01-02
At 0330 January 2, the F/V Robert Henry ran aground at the south tip of Cape Arago near Coos Bay, Oregon. The 39-foot fishing vessel reportedly has 400 gallons of diesel aboard. USCG Sector Columbia River requested the NOAA SSC provide information on oil fate and transport.
